subject: pe
title: Trait vs State Anxiety
welcome_lead: Personality versus situation — Spielberger's STAI distinguishes the two.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on anxiety measurement and management.
final_note: Trait anxiety is the predisposition; state anxiety is the moment — measure both.

concepts.def: Stable personality disposition to feel anxious.
Transient anxiety in a specific situation.
Competitive State Anxiety Inventory; measures cognitive, somatic and confidence.
Real-time physiological feedback used to teach arousal control.
CBT technique to challenge and replace anxiety-inducing thoughts.

walkthroughs.body_html: High-trait athletes show stronger state-anxiety responses to similar stressors.
9-item subscales for cognitive anxiety, somatic anxiety and self-confidence — Martens 1990.
Combining cognitive (self-talk, restructuring) and somatic (relaxation, biofeedback) techniques is most effective.
